Twelve comments

An excellent 7/8 tune in A harmonic minor from a group called Kasír, from their album “Reel Irish”:
https://thesession.org/recordings/2021

As I bought the album from iTunes, I don’t have the liner notes, but according to their website, the tune is credited to Rune Cygan Barslund, Kasír’s whistle and accordion player, and Ivan Milev, whom I don’t know anything about currently.

I’m not sure why there is one more bar in the last part, but it works for me. I really love the second part especially… Strangely pretty…

↳ Posted by Joseph Chordmichael on January 31st, 2009.

Re: Mileva Ruchenitza

The first setting is NOT in “A harmonic minor”, but rather in E hijaz (which I would write in ABC as K:Ephr ^g).
So the second setting is in B hijaz (K:Bphr ^d) and the second setting is in F# hijaz (K:F# ^a).
Ivan Milev is a legendary Bulgarian accordion player.
Here’s himself playing this tune with his band:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6nxIeTOANmc

I think Kasir rewrote the tune a bit, which is why one of the members claims part in composition.
